name: Header
description: YAMI global navigation band. At and above 1024px: brand lockup, storefront hall switcher, locale, deliver-to, search, account / cart, and a category rail whose entries are campaign artwork rather than icon components. Below 1024px it swaps to the mobile chrome — a 56px brand bar (lockup, deliver-to, inbox) over a 36px search field with visual search. The two are different anatomies, not a reflow.

figma.notes: PC geometry and token bindings were reconciled against the production www.yami.com/en header at 1480px, because the Figma node was not reachable when this component was built. The mobile band is measured directly from node 2725:151904.

logo.description: Brand lockup artwork. PC renders the assets/logos/yami-ui-<lang>-pc-fill.svg lockup at 52px tall.

mobileLogo.description: Brand lockup below 1024px. Renders the assets/logos/yami-ui-<lang>-mobile-fill.svg lockup at 32px tall — a distinct Figma variant with its own mark / wordmark proportions, not the PC file scaled down. Falls back to logo.

darkLogo.description: Brand lockup on dark surfaces. Renders assets/logos/yami-ui-<lang>-pc-fill-inverse.svg — the same locked lockup with a white wordmark, since Fill's #222222 wordmark is invisible on a dark band. Swapped by the .dark class in CSS, not JS. Omit and the band keeps logo in dark mode.

darkMobileLogo.description: Dark-surface counterpart to mobileLogo, from assets/logos/yami-ui-<lang>-mobile-fill-inverse.svg. Omit to keep mobileLogo.

homeHref.description: Destination for the brand lockup. Defaults to the site root.

halls.description: Storefront halls rendered as an inline radiogroup left of the search field (All | Beauty). These scope the storefront, not the search query. EN-only: the CN storefront ships no hall switcher, so omit this there — Header then separates the lockup from the locale / deliver-to group with a rule instead.

hallId.description: Controlled active hall id. Uncontrolled selection falls back to the first hall.

zipcode.description: Deliver-to control beside the locale switcher and before the search field. Omit to hide it.

categories.description: Category rail entries in display order. Each entry's image renders as a 24px , never an icon component; omitting image yields the built-in grid glyph used by the leading Categories entry.

searchPlaceholder.description: Localized placeholder for the query field. Production rotates hot searches through this slot; rotation is the caller's concern.

searchValue.description: Controlled query. Leave undefined for an uncontrolled field.

onSearchSubmit.description: Fires on form submit with the current query.

onScan.description: Visual search, mobile field only. Omit while the entry is not configured.

account.description: Account entry point. Its label is rendered visibly beside the glyph and is also the accessible name.

locale.description: Country flag artwork rendered at 20px, plus a short locale code such as EN. It lives in the left brand group immediately before deliver-to. Use the maintained DS icons in assets/icons/area/.

cart.description: Cart entry point. The count is folded into the accessible name only — the chrome renders no visible count.

inbox.description: Message centre entry in the mobile brand bar, below 1024px only. The PC band routes messages through the account menu, so this has no desktop counterpart. Omit to hide it.

ariaLabel.description: Localized accessible name for the banner landmark.

hallsLabel.description: Localized accessible name for the hall radiogroup.

categoriesLabel.description: Localized accessible name for the category rail navigation region.

searchLabel.description: Localized accessible name for the search landmark, field, and submit control.

scanLabel.description: Localized accessible name for the mobile field's visual-search control. The control is mobile-only.

nextCategoriesLabel.description: Localized accessible name for the rail's forward paging control.

previousCategoriesLabel.description: Localized accessible name for the rail's backward paging control.

redUsage.note: Category promotion badges are the only red in the chrome and use --text-emphasis. Counts and promotion flags such as NEW qualify; decorative labels do not.

semanticColorOnly.note: No non-semantic hue is baked into the CSS. The band resolves to --surface-primary and exposes no tinting escape hatch.

tapTarget.note: Account, locale, cart, and category entries clear 44px. The 18px hall text controls and the 40px deliver-to control keep their visual size and gain a transparent 44px hit area.

focus.note: Brand, halls, deliver-to, account, locale, cart, category links, rail paging, and the submit button expose a 2px --border-focus outline at 2px offset.

radius.note: Only semantic radius slots. Production's 20px / 16px / 18px pills are all fully-rounded boxes, so they map to --radius-button-primary; focusable text controls use --radius-component-default.

typeHierarchy.note: Three levels in the chrome: link-md (halls, deliver-to, account), body-md (query field), caption-sm (category labels and promotion badges), plus link-sm for the locale code.

numeralsFont.note: The deliver-to postal code and promotion counts inherit --font-family-ios from the header root.

elevationOnPress.note: Hover changes background-color only. The rail paging controls separate from scrolling content with a 1px --border-default ring rather than a shadow, matching production.

noOpacityDisabled.note: Rail paging controls unmount at the boundaries rather than dimming, matching production's display:none, so no disabled styling is required.

borderStrength.note: Production uses #000 for the search ring, 17% black for the cart ring and rail divider, #f5f5f5 for the row rule, and #222 for the closing rule. The DS caps borders at three strengths, so these map to --border-focus, --border-default / --divider-subtle, --border-default, and --divider-emphasis respectively.

--border-focus.selector: .search ring at --stroke-thick; outline-color on every focusable slot

accessibility.role: banner landmark containing a search landmark and a category navigation region
accessibility.ariaPattern: header banner + role=search form + nav with a list of category links; halls form an exclusive radiogroup
accessibility.structure: Category artwork carries the category name as alt and repeats it as a visible label. The leading Categories entry uses a decorative glyph and relies on its visible label. The account control shows its label visibly. The locale control names itself via aria-label and hides the short code from assistive technology. The cart folds its item count into aria-label because the chrome shows no visible count.
accessibility.interaction: The category rail scrolls natively; paging controls page by one viewport minus a single anchor entry and unmount at the boundaries. Reduced motion switches paging to immediate scrolling. Promotion badges sit in the category entry's top-right corner and are clipped to one line so a multi-badge entry cannot change the row height.
accessibility.notes: PC only. Below 1024px the rail scrolls rather than reflowing — the mobile header is a separate component.
